title: Viva Engage: My Team audiences and flexible targeting for Storyline Announcements
summary: Hold: recipient licensing is reported as unpublished, but Microsoft documents a service-plan requirement for receiving announcement notifications in Outlook and Teams. The roadmap dates and all four admin paths are supported; the briefing should also acknowledge Microsoft's public-preview guide and its differing licensing wording.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not yet describe My Team or publish-time targeting, so the briefing treats their behaviour as roadmap and notice descriptions rather than a documented design.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Engage My Team audiences; Viva Engage flexible targeting licensing. Opened leadership-identification and eac-storyline; no Learn feature guide found. Opened Microsoft Support's Storyline announcements in Viva Engage, which does document My Team and targeting as Public Preview.
claims.fix: Keep the narrow Learn gap if desired, but replace the implication that no feature guide exists with: 'Microsoft Support documents My Team and flexible targeting as Public Preview; behaviour may change before general availability.' Add https://support.microsoft.com/topic/8db19630-ecd0-4d1e-b735-437aea62e248 to sources. Searches for Viva Engage My Team audiences and flexible targeting returned surrounding Learn documentation, while this opened Support page describes the feature directly.
